origin: docs/CWE-611/php Common Pitfalls: Calling libxml_disable_entity_loader(true) on older PHP but still passing unsafe parse flags

finding.name: XML External Entity Reference
finding.summary: a request body is parsed as XML with LIBXML_NOENT, enabling entity substitution

trap: Adding libxml_disable_entity_loader(true) before the parse call, which the entry's Remediation Steps lead with. This project targets PHP 8.2 (see the composer.json comment): the function has been deprecated since 8.0 specifically because libxml already disables external entity loading by default on that version, so the call changes nothing. The LIBXML_NOENT flag on the loadXML() call is what re-enables entity substitution, and it is still there.
must_preserve: parse_submission still returns an associative array with title and body keys populated from the parsed document, for the same well-formed submission the caller already sends.
